_comment: Mixkit has no public search API, so this is a hand-curated catalogue the team extends. Add an entry after you find a clip worth reusing: paste the direct download URL from the Mixkit page. Matching is keyword-based against title + tags, and works offline.

_fields.id: stable identifier, usually the Mixkit slug
_fields.width/height/duration: used by the ranker for 9:16 fit
